about: Libraries checked to work in Weave games: Weave lists these in Project Settings ▸ Libraries ▸ Add from the Weave library index, fetches the chosen one at its pin, and checks it again on arrival.

libraries.name: actuate
libraries.description: Tweening with chained calls: any property, delays, repeats, callbacks.
libraries.summary: compiles for the web and for native

libraries.name: tink_core
libraries.description: Futures, outcomes, signals and other building blocks.
libraries.summary: compiles for the web and for native

libraries.name: hxjsonast
libraries.description: JSON parsing and printing that keeps where each value came from.
libraries.summary: compiles for the web and for native

libraries.name: json2object
libraries.description: Typed JSON: parse straight into your own classes, with errors that say where.
libraries.summary: compiles for the web and for native

libraries.name: format
libraries.description: Readers and writers for file formats: PNG, ZIP, WAV, TGA, BMP and more.
libraries.summary: compiles for the web and for native with 2 module(s) left out; left out: format.tools.MemoryInput, format.tools.MemoryBytes (for the web, it is written for flash, which a Weave game never is; for native, it is written for flash, which a Weave game never is)

libraries.name: hscript
libraries.description: A Haxe interpreter: run script text a player or a mod writes.
libraries.summary: compiles for the web and for native with 1 module(s) left out; left out: hscript.JsInterp (for native, it uses the browser's own objects, which a native game does not have)

libraries.name: markdown
libraries.description: Markdown to HTML or a tree of nodes, for in-game help and text.
libraries.summary: compiles for the web and for native

libraries.name: stb_perlin
libraries.description: Perlin noise in one C header: terrain, clouds, wobble.
libraries.summary: 6 function(s) bound and compiled: stb_perlin_noise3, stb_perlin_noise3_seed, stb_perlin_ridge_noise3, stb_perlin_fbm_noise3, stb_perlin_turbulence_noise3, stb_perlin_noise3_wrap_nonpow2

libraries.name: FastNoiseLite
libraries.description: Fast noise in C: OpenSimplex, cellular, value, fractals, domain warp.
libraries.summary: 69 function(s) bound and compiled: fnlCreateState, fnlGetNoise2D, fnlGetNoise3D, fnlDomainWarp2D, fnlDomainWarp2D_x, fnlDomainWarp2D_y, …

libraries.name: cJSON
libraries.description: A small, fast JSON parser and printer in C.
libraries.summary: 83 function(s) bound and compiled: cJSON_Version, cJSON_InitHooks, cJSON_Parse, cJSON_ParseWithLength, cJSON_Print, cJSON_PrintUnformatted, …

libraries.name: tinyexpr
libraries.description: Evaluate maths typed as text, such as "sqrt(x^2 + 1)": for formulas and mods.
libraries.summary: 2 function(s) bound and compiled: te_interp, te_interp_error

libraries.name: lz4
libraries.description: Very fast compression: smaller save files and downloads.
libraries.summary: 22 function(s) bound and compiled: LZ4_versionNumber, LZ4_versionString, LZ4_compress_default, LZ4_decompress_safe, LZ4_compressBound, LZ4_compress_fast, …
